description: Verifies the one-dimensional polynomial chaos expansion: exact mean, variance and standard deviation of a linear function of a Gaussian variable on the Hermite basis, the mean of a quadratic function of a uniform variable on the Legendre basis, and the median extracted from sampled quantiles.

checks.section: Hermite basis with a Gaussian variable
checks.label: the mean of 3 + 2 xi equals 3

checks.section: Hermite basis with a Gaussian variable
checks.label: the variance of 3 + 2 xi equals 4

checks.section: Hermite basis with a Gaussian variable
checks.label: the standard deviation of 3 + 2 xi equals 2

checks.section: Legendre basis with a uniform variable
checks.label: the mean of 1 + 3 xi^2 over a uniform variable on [-1, 1] equals 2
